title: Work Board data file
description: Single source of truth for a project's Work Board. Rendered by templates/render-work-board.py, which also validates it. Operator decisions never live here; an item that waits on the Operator names the Check-in Desk ask (CK id) it waits on.

maintainer.description: The role that keeps the board current.

tz_label.description: Time-zone label shown after times, e.g. PT. All times in the file are in this zone.

updated.description: ISO datetime of this version. Rewritten in the same edit as any content change.

desk.description: Optional name or link of the project's Check-in Desk, shown in the header.

items.description: Every WI id ever assigned. Ids are positive integers, unique, contiguous from 1, never renumbered or dropped (a dropped item stays, with its reason). Unknown fields are rejected.

adopted.description: ISO date the board's discipline began. Done items closed before it are history: belongs_to and proof optional, shown as operator-reported. Absent means every done item needs both.

theme.description: Color token overrides. The only visual customization a project may make.

owner.description: The role that owns the item.

state.description: backlog: wanted, not scheduled. committed: named for a week or date. doing: in hand. blocked: waits on a desk ask or another item. held: waits on an external event with a date. done: closed with proof. dropped: closed without doing, with a reason.

belongs_to.description: What bounds this work: a tranche, an issue record, a control document, an ADR, a decision (CK id), or an evidence folder. Required for doing, and for done unless closed before 'adopted'.

initiative.description: Optional tag; the entity layer reads it.

depends_on.description: WI ids that must close first. Ordering only; not a reason to be blocked.

waits_on.description: blocked: {ask: {project, id}} (a Check-in Desk ask) or {item: WI id}. held: {event, by?} (an external event; by is an ISO date). Absent on every other state.

needed_by.description: ISO date or datetime. Informs the Due this week count; never changes a state on its own.

closed_on.description: ISO date. Required for done and dropped.

proof.description: Required for done unless closed before 'adopted'. An artifact in Velocity's terms: review pack, handoff packet, closeout disposition, receipt id, or record path. Cited, not judged, by the board.

origin.description: Present when the item exists because a peer entity asked; their project and their id.

automated.description: True when the item's normal path runs without an agent. Counted, so the project can measure it.

source.description: Provenance: where this item came from (a queue paragraph, a log line). Kept, not rendered.

uncertain.description: Fields the maintainer could not confirm, each exactly '<field>: <why>' where <field> is a real field name. Rendered as an 'unconfirmed: <fields>' tag; the reasons show on hover.

then.description: proof and belongs_to also required unless closed_on is before the board's adopted date (renderer-checked)

title.description: Recurring assurance work: a reconcile, an audit, a periodic package. Never leaves the board.

last_completed.description: ISO date of the last completion, or null if never. Next due is computed from it.

proof.description: Proof of the last completion. Required when last_completed is set.

evidence.description: Path pattern where every completion's proof lives, e.g. private/daily-control-YYYYMMDD/RECEIPT.json. 'proof' holds the last one; 'evidence' says where the next will be.

source.description: Provenance: where this item came from (a queue paragraph, a log line). Kept, not rendered.

uncertain.description: Fields the maintainer could not confirm, each '<field>: <why>'. Rendered as an 'unconfirmed' tag naming the fields.

planned.description: True when the control is defined but not yet built. Shown as 'not yet built' and not counted as due or never-run until it exists.
